observableDefect.title: The lab was not the canvas. It iframed a different probe, so no R1 evidence came from the declared canvas, and its furniture named the tenant on screen.
findings: page.tsx imported @/components/torture-sections/registry and embedded /probe/whitelabel-torture/scenes/* — a consumption edge into a tree no R1 lane owns and this round may not change.

The torture furniture heading reads 'Whitelabel torture — bithire'. Any capture containing that string cannot serve as evidence for the three-second RECOGNITION test, which is exactly what R1 asks the lab to prove.
The torture sections are a paint-channel probe built for pixel regression. A reference lab needs a judgement instrument: grammar strip, state row, composition vignette, content torture.
observableDefect.consequence: R1 exit requires the lab to render both tenant sources from canonical authorities with zero product application dependency. Neither the provenance nor the furniture met that.

standardControlsUsed: @rottay/design-system/server for the first-paint seam and the tenant compile
proControlsAndRecipesUsed: Two EXPLICIT tenant route segments, each with its own layout mounting its own ground, rather than one segment with a tenant parameter. A layout may own the ground because the tenant is static per segment, so no searchParams plumbing is needed — and two ~20-line layouts with zero conditionals make 'no tenant conditional TSX' visible in review instead of argued.
visualAuthority='compiled-artifact' for the DB ground so the server embed stays the single authority and the provider emits no competing layer.
Tenant-blind furniture: no chrome component accepts a tenant prop, so the recognition test cannot be contaminated by a caption.
responsiveStrategy: Captures are taken from plain URLs at real 320/390/768/1440 viewports so fixed, dvh and media-query behaviour is measured against the true viewport rather than an iframe's box, and so capture provenance is a URL rather than a parent page's layout.
mobileSimplification: The scene sections use flex-wrap and intrinsic sizing only; the lab imposes no layout of its own that could mask a family's responsive behaviour.
statesAndMotion: The state row focuses a control programmatically on mount so the real focus-visible ring is photographed rather than a faked class. Hover and press are deliberately NOT faked with forced props; they belong in the recordings the evidence contract requires.
i18nRtlA11y: Content torture carries real Spanish and Arabic strings, with the Arabic specimen wrapped dir='rtl' to exercise mirroring, plus an unbroken 60-character token as the per-character-wrap trap.

expectedTenantDivergence.law: the lab does not author divergence; it renders the two canonical authorities and lets the captures show what is there
expectedTenantDivergence.verified: under the two grounds --ds-color-primary resolves rgb(58,111,176) vs rgb(26,26,24), --ds-font-family-heading resolves Space Grotesk vs Fraunces, and 26 modern-engine buttons render on both

integratorRequests.reason: the lab renders the canvas but every evidence artifact produced from it is owned by the quality integrator
integratorRequests.disposition: fulfilled for the control scene: 8 captures banked under captures/cohort-1/control/

honestStatus: IN_PROGRESS. The lab is self-contained and both grounds render correctly and distinctly, verified by computed-style measurement rather than by eye. ONE of four scenes exists (control); field, overlay and feedback are not built. The ?judge=grayscale and ?judge=hue-neutral overlays are implemented in the ground but no judged captures have been taken. The torture harness was left completely untouched — this lab simply stopped pointing at it.
